input.title: Zombie Match beta player messages - note for the team (Oct 1)
input.bodyText:
Zombie Match beta player messages: where we stand (Oct 1)

The calls for all 32 messages are in "Zombie Match beta player messages - calls (Oct 1)" in the same folder. They cover the 14 rows on the PNs Beta tab plus every ask filed on a ticket. Each one went through Leonard's Beta message rule.
Result: 2 Go, 24 Hold, 6 Drop. The PN sheet says 6 are Ready, but only 2 pass all six tests.

1. D1 and D7, Sep 15 cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%
iOS is 70% of that week's installs and is behind Android on both D1 and D7.

2. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day
The client only schedules these once our own permission ask has run (after level 20) or the player switches notifications on in settings. Each time the game goes to the background it clears and reschedules them, so they only fire if the player doesn't come back.
- Day 1: Lapsed 1 day, "The Horde Is Growing… 🧟‍♂️". Go.
- Days 2 to 6: nothing. A day-3 reminder was asked for (DES-342) but the client doesn't schedule one, so it's a Hold.
- Day 7: Lapsed 7 days. Go. Final headline is "Your Squad Needs You Back"; the client still ships "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱". String change is DES-346.
- Days 14, 21, 28: the same 7-day message repeats, so the Lapsed 14 days ask (DES-344) is already covered and is a Drop.
- Day 30: nothing. The last reminder is day 28 (DES-343 is a Hold).

3. Messages the client already schedules that are still a Hold
- Lives recharged / Full Ammo (DES-315). Fails test 6, not seen on both. On iOS store build 0.3.49 it didn't arrive after a full refill (Vincent, Sep 30), so his iOS tick is off. Android passed on 0.3.127.
- Finish first mission (DES-318). Fails test 4, can't reach its audience. It's for players below level 20, and our permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert, Sep 29). None of them count; the settings toggle doesn't count.
- Plague Race (DES-319). Fails test 6, not seen on both. Vincent's iOS pass came from a 5-minute timer build, and on real iOS 0.3.40 it never arrived. Android is fine.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320). Fails test 5, wrong day. The client fires it 7, 14, 21 and 28 days after the last session, not on the weekly reset, which the server sets.

4. Everything else
- 20 other Holds aren't scheduled by the client yet: 14 fail test 3 (the client could send them with a local timer) and 6 fail test 2 (they need a server send). Held tickets go to Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out (ZM ROADMAP BETA list).
- 6 Drops: Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena aren't in the beta. Comeback gift on tap is a v2 idea. Lapsed 14 days is already covered by the 7-day message.
- The 2 Go messages are on the checklist on the push notifications card on ZM ROADMAP for Vincent to tick off.

subject: Your beta push notification asks: what happened
body:
Hi Brian,

We ran every beta phone-message ask through Leonard's Beta message rule. Here's where yours landed:

- DES-328 Endless entries are back: Hold. The client doesn't schedule it yet (test 3). Entries come back on a local timer, so it can be built client-side later.

- DES-333 Season Pass premium nudge: Hold. It needs a server send (test 2), because the target is picked per player from server data.
- DES-345 Comeback gift on tap: Drop. A reward on tap is a v2 idea and isn't in the beta (test 1).

Held tickets are in Backlog, unassigned, until the beta build is out. The canceled one is closed. The reasoning is on each ticket.

Thanks,
Samuel
